title: Check-in, v1 (server SDKs)
description: A host saying it can reach the service: POST /v1/checkins with this body, Authorization: Bearer <server secret>. Once an hour from the host's scheduler, and on `php artisan mybeast:errors-test` - so an environment with no errors can be told from one that cannot send. Answered 202 {"heard": true, "project": <slug>, "environment": <name>}.
